text:
vika: Alert: ap-southeast1 etcd leader CPU 98% for ~3m during a GPU pool scale-up. apiserver p95 latency ~2.1s, controller-manager started crashlooping. WAL fsync stalls in logs. Investigating.

sre-oncall-bot: [ALERT] etcd-leader-cpu-high triggered at 2025-11-12T13:40:10Z — severity: high — runbook: /runbooks/etcd-cpu.md

anya: ack. grabbing leader snapshots and vm metrics.

kevin: looking at VPC egress counters — SNAT ports near exhaustion on nat-gw-apse1. Lots of short-lived connections to 2379/2380 from attach-controller.

infra-ops: confirmed — GPU autoscaler triggered ~120 attach ops in 2m. Each attach opens connections to control-plane endpoints (token exchange + attach). If connections aren't reusing ports, we hit 64k limit quickly.

taylor: mitigation idea: scale down GPU autoscaler by 50% to throttle attach rate, and add another NAT gateway to spread ports. Can do both now.

kevin: quick check: `netstat -anp | grep 2379 | wc -l` -> 43212 connections. `ss -s` shows high ephemeral port usage.

anya: controller-manager logs show repeated "failed to acquire lease: context deadline exceeded" and k8s client timeouts. excerpt:

```
2025-11-12T13:39:58Z controller-manager error: PUT /api/v1/namespaces/kube-system/leases/leader: dial tcp 10.0.5.12:2379: i/o timeout
2025-11-12T13:40:01Z etcd leader: WAL fsync backlog 120ms
```

vikram: I don't want to restart etcd leader unless absolutely necessary. Prefer to relieve load and let leader catch up. I'll add a NAT gw and patch route table.

infra-ops: spun up nat-gw-apse1-b and attached to the cluster's egress route table. Also enabled default connection tracking reuse on the attach service (keep-alive). Observing immediate spill — leader CPU down to ~62% and active conns dropping to ~9k.

vika: apiserver p95 down to 180ms, controller-manager crashloop stopped — :thumbsup:

taylor: follow-ups (postmortem actions):
- INF ticket: https://incidents.redwood/INF-1229 (created)
- Add autoscaler circuit-breaker: max attach/sec per AZ, backoff policy.
- Add dedicated persistent egress pool or static NAT IPs for attach-controller to avoid port exhaustion.
- Add metric: etcd_wal_fsync_latency and alert at 50ms sustained.

anya: I'll own the ticket and draft the postmortem. Assigning to infra-ops for NAT changes and to platform for autoscaler throttling.

kevin: suggestion: make attach-controller use persistent HTTP/2 or connection pooling for control-plane ops so we don't open ephemeral sockets repeatedly.

vikram: noted. I'll pair with platform next week to wire connection reuse. For now, keep nat-gw-b active for 24h and monitor.

vika: thanks all — closing the alert but keeping the thread for the follow-up items.

sre-oncall-bot: Incident INF-1229 recorded. Priority: P2. Runbook step logged by anya.
